title_zh: 约定按署名表更正联合说明会采访稿

scenario.label_zh: 约定按署名表更正联合说明会采访稿
scenario.goal_zh: 核对三位发言人的机构身份与发言次序，并约定据此更正采访稿

context_zh: 虚构联合说明会后，两位记者依现场署名表和录音核对三位发言人。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: I've mixed up the speakers in my notes. Was Luis speaking for the school?

sentences.speaker: Lewis
sentences.text: No. The name sheet lists him as the council spokesman. He spoke first about the road closure.

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: Then Mara was the campaign spokeswoman, asking for a crossing near the school?

sentences.speaker: Lewis
sentences.text: Exactly. And Dev was the school's spokesperson. Dev spoke last, about the entrance pupils use.

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: That explains the timing on the recording. I'd put Dev's answer under Luis's name.

sentences.speaker: Lewis
sentences.text: Use the name sheet for their titles and the recording for who said what. Don't attribute the campaign's demand to the council.

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: I'll correct those three attributions before sending the draft back to you.

sentences.speaker: Lewis
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll check the corrected version against the recording.

targets.sense_zh: 事件发生的时间安排或时序
